primary.label: Combined portfolio (all strategies)

scenario.label: Repository defaults (primary)
scenario.note: The repository's configured risk policy, entry cap and daily profit target, used unchanged. This is the reference scenario; no setting is overridden.

conflict_policy.same_bar_priority: lower priority value wins a same-(timeframe, candle) conflict
conflict_policy.duplicate_exposure: a second open position on the same timeframe and direction is rejected as duplicate_exposure
conflict_policy.duplicate_signal: a repeated setup id is rejected as duplicate_signal

metrics.cost_scenario_basis: Uses the per-bar spread of each trade's entry and exit candles (averaged into one width). Measured, not assumed; trades without a per-bar spread fall back to the measured mean and are counted as such.
metrics.close_note: signal_win_rate = profitable closed trades / signals generated; closed_trade_win_rate = profitable closed trades / closed trades; risk_approval_rate = risk-approved signals / signals generated. A risk-approved signal is never counted as a win.

assumptions: Entry is simulated at the confirming candle's close (no slippage); it is the first actionable price after the signal bar had closed.
A position still open at the end of the data is marked to the final close and reported as end_of_data, separately from closed trades.
Same-candle stop/target uses the conservative stop-first rule unless exact-tiling M1 bars prove the target came first.
P&L is mark-to-market via default_calc_profit and costs use the measured per-bar spread (one full width per closed trade).
Position sizing and every risk limit use the repository's own RiskPolicy and size_position maths; no strategy rule is modified.

conservative.label: Combined portfolio (all strategies)

scenario.label: Conservative comparison (explicitly configured)
scenario.note: Labeled comparison scenario requested by the brief: 0.25% risk per trade, 1% daily loss limit, one open position, at most four new entries per risk day, a 1.5 minimum planned reward/risk and the same $10 daily profit stop. Strategy-specific stop/target/confirmation rules are unchanged; only account-level numbers are tightened.
